title: Raise the source budget maximum above 60 s (for example 300000 ms) while keeping the 60 s default
outcome: Raise the source budget maximum above 60 s (for example 300000 ms) while keeping the 60 s default
acceptance: `engram source --timeout-ms` accepts values up to a raised maximum (for example 300000 ms); the default stays 60000 and values below 60000 are still raised to 60000
A behavioural test shows a request above 60000 and within the new maximum is honoured as one absolute budget, and a value above the maximum still refuses
